title: pt tax
description:
Realized gains by holding period with an estimated liability.

`disclaimer` is REQUIRED to be a non-empty string here, and `excludes_wash_sales` is required to be present. A tax report that quietly omitted either would be the silently-wrong-number failure mode by definition.

excludes_wash_sales.description: True until wash-sale detection lands in v0.2. A const, so that flipping it silently is impossible: the schema has to change too.
